title: Stone2 솔로 #59 · amazon bombshell · 석재 unakite · 대리석 홀 · 잉크 블랙립
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, shaggy layered jet-black hair — full body polished unakite fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING olive-green unakite surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID salmon-pink speckles flowing through every section, with thin brass inlay lines running along the grain of every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: one hand trailing along her thigh, the other behind her back, hip tilted — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the unakite body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left forearm, and one chipped-off piece at her left hip, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw grey-green stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the unakite is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals in red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved unakite right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, carved from the same unakite with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a blurred ink-black gradient across the lids like soft smoke, a fine black liner, natural full lashes, a glass-skin highlight on the cheekbones, ink-black glossy lips with a softly blurred gradient edge. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved unakite.

Background: a bright grand hall with a pale marble floor, tall columns, standard-height arched doors and soft golden daylight through high windows, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
